free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: GuidedGen needs a non-empty opset; no operator is executed, only the placeholder guidance path is used

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: the initialized placeholder is irrelevant to the branch, so a rank-1 placeholder keeps setup minimal

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes the random shuffle and bin choice so every run makes the same back-off decisions

free_parameters.name: constrain_prob
free_parameters.why: disables the random skip of guidance so all constructed constraints reach the back-off loop

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: dtype of the constructed placeholder is not read by the target decision

free_parameters.name: guidance_bin
free_parameters.why: each generated guidance is x >= 1; combined with the solver setup it creates the unsat/sat pattern

free_parameters.name: solver_setup
free_parameters.value: n_cons=1: p_0==0; n_cons>=2: each n_i>=0 and sum(n_i)<=n_cons-1
free_parameters.why: controls whether the whole guidance set is unsat and whether a single surviving constraint is sat

execution.entry_reason: The step-4 call chain is synthetic: it pairs the same-file artifact entry random_model_gen with the target function. In the pinned commit random_model_gen constructs PureSymbolGen, whose post_process is a no-op, so GuidedGen.post_process is unreachable from the official entry. To exercise the Region branch itself, the driver constructs a real GuidedGen and calls its real post_process; the solver/graph attributes are scenario inputs.
